parametros_equipo_desc.timeout_puerta: Maximum time for the door to finish opening or closing.
parametros_equipo_desc.temp_max_apertura: Above this chamber temperature the door does not open.
parametros_equipo_desc.rango_presion_atm: Band around atmospheric pressure in which the chamber is considered at atmospheric pressure to open the door.
parametros_equipo_desc.intervalo_impresion: How often a line is printed during the cycle.
parametros_equipo_desc.intervalo_impresion_esterilizacion: How often a line is printed during sterilization.
parametros_equipo_desc.temp_segura_drenaje: Drain temperature ceiling; above it, water cooling turns on.
parametros_equipo_desc.rango_temp_drenaje: Tolerance over the safe temperature before the alarm.
parametros_equipo_desc.presion_empaque: Door gasket pressure to consider it sealed.
parametros_equipo_desc.vacio_empaque: Pressure below which the gasket is considered deflated.
parametros_equipo_desc.timeout_chaqueta: Maximum time for the jacket to reach its pressure. Not yet used by the control.
parametros_equipo_desc.tiempo_standby: Minutes without activity before the screens go to standby; 0 disables it.
parametros_equipo_desc.tiempo_estable_alarma: Time a condition must hold before the alarm is raised or cleared.
parametros_equipo_desc.pausa_max_esterilizacion_s: Maximum total of pauses caused by missing control board data in one sterilization. If exceeded, the cycle fails due to unstable communication.
parametros_equipo_desc.espera_sellado_sin_sonda_min: Liquid load: if the Main probe is lost during cooling and no other valid probe remains, the chamber waits sealed for this time before venting through the slow exhaust.
parametros_equipo_desc.presion_atmosferica: Atmospheric pressure at the installation site.

instalacion.activacion_ayuda: Especifika issues the code for this serial number. It is valid only on the day it is generated.
instalacion.puertas_fija: This equipment type has a single door.
instalacion.enfriamiento_ayuda: 0 = no cooling. The maximum depends on the equipment type.
instalacion.vapor_generator_desc: The unit generates its own steam; the generator has its own controls (no DO1/DO2 outputs)
instalacion.vapor_boiler_desc: Connection to the customer's steam supply
instalacion.vapor_mixed_desc: Circuit that alternates between the internal generator and an external boiler
instalacion.camara_vista_previa_ayuda: Calculated by the software with the Especifika naming scheme. It is locked with the profile.
instalacion.error_capacidad: Enter a whole-number capacity from 20 to 2000 L
instalacion.error_clase_fuera_alcance: This software can only be installed on hospital and laboratory units
instalacion.suministros_ayuda: Enable only the inputs wired on this equipment. A disabled input is not monitored: no alarm and no interlock.
instalacion.sondas_ayuda: Chamber probe 1 controls the cycle and cannot be disabled.
instalacion.resumen_aviso: Once installed, the profile is locked and cannot be changed from the software.
instalacion.confirmar_pregunta: Install the equipment with this data? The profile will be locked.
instalacion.listo_texto: The equipment has been registered successfully. Press Continue to start using it.
instalacion.confirmar_sin_cerrojo: The selected door type does NOT control the door lock. Confirm that the equipment has no lock before installing. The profile will be locked.

opciones.equipo_err_empaque: Gasket pressure must stay at least 20 kPa above atmospheric and gasket vacuum at least 10 kPa below.
opciones.equipo_guia: Changes can only be made with no cycle running and apply without restarting the unit.

equipo_grupos_desc.camara_segura: Maximum opening temperature and atmospheric band
equipo_grupos_desc.maquina: Language, units, serial number and model

opciones.equipo_err_ciclo: Unit parameters cannot be changed while a cycle is running.
opciones.equipo_err_rango: Value out of the allowed range.
opciones.equipo_motivo_rol: Your role can only view these parameters.
opciones.equipo_motivo_ciclo: Unit parameters cannot be changed while a cycle is running.
opciones.equipo_atm_ayuda: Only the automatic calibration changes it (Maintenance).
opciones.equipo_motivo_idioma_rol: Only the administrator and the engineer change the language.
opciones.equipo_motivo_unidades_rol: Only the engineer changes the units.
opciones.equipo_motivo_unidades_ciclo: Units cannot be changed while a cycle is running.
opciones.equipo_presion_nota: Absolute; psi is gauge and vacuum in inHg.
opciones.err_unidades_cambiaron: Units changed: type the value again.
opciones.err_conversion: The value cannot be converted (no calibrated atmospheric pressure, or negative psi).
opciones.equipo_unidades_ayuda: Only changes what is shown and typed; control stays in °C and absolute kPa. kPa, bar and mbar are absolute; psi is gauge (psig) and, below atmospheric, inches of mercury vacuum (inHg).
opciones.equipo_err_unidades_ciclo: Units can only be changed outside a cycle.
opciones.entradas_nota: Choose what Pre-cycle and Cycle show, in this order. Input 1 is required; sensors set to Not in use in the program are not listed.
opciones.err_entradas_repetidas: An input cannot be repeated in two rows.
opciones.err_sensor_no_en_uso: The program has that sensor set to Not in use: it cannot be shown.
opciones.gestion_movida: To create, duplicate, enable, disable or delete programs: Advanced options › Cycle management.
opciones.borrar_programa_pregunta: Delete program {nombre}? Its number will not be used again.
opciones.programa_deshabilitado: Program disabled: it is not offered in Pre-cycle.
opciones.err_programa_activo: Not possible with the selected program.
opciones.equipo_impresora_ayuda: When disabled, the unit does not warn when the printer is not connected.
opciones.equipo_reinicio_pregunta: The software will restart to apply the change.
opciones.equipo_reinicio_aviso: If the software does not reopen within 1 minute, turn the unit off and on again.
opciones.equipo_err_reinicio_no_disponible: The software cannot be restarted from this screen: the change was not saved.
opciones.equipo_err_reinicio_en_curso: The unit is already shutting down or restarting.
opciones.equipo_err_reinicio_estado_seguro: The software cannot restart while the chamber is being brought to a safe state: the change was not saved.
opciones.equipo_err_reinicio_confirmacion: Confirm the safe state first; then the software can restart. The change was not saved.
opciones.equipo_err_reinicio_modo_prueba: Exit output test mode first; the change was not saved.
opciones.equipo_err_guardar: The equipment settings could not be saved.
opciones.sin_secciones: Your profile has no sections available
opciones.solo_lectura_rol: Read only: your role can view this section but not change it
opciones.salir_pregunta: There are unsaved changes. Exit and discard them?
opciones.guardar_parametro_pregunta: This parameter has unsaved changes. Save them?
opciones.cambiar_seccion_pregunta: There are unsaved changes. Change section and discard them?
opciones.programa_no_editable: Factory or damaged program: read only.
opciones.sensores_instruccion: Assign the role of each sensor for this cycle
opciones.sensores_nota: A new Main sensor replaces the previous one, which becomes Not in use.
opciones.leyenda_defecto: * Value different from the default value. Every change is recorded with its user.
opciones.toque_nuevo_valor: Tap to enter the new value
opciones.err_bloqueada: Editing locked: the equipment is not in preparation. Finish or cancel the cycle to change parameters.
opciones.err_valor_cambio: The value changed on the equipment (now {valor}). Check it and try again.
opciones.err_rol: Your user is not allowed to change this parameter.
opciones.err_identidad: The session could not be identified. Log out and log in again.
opciones.err_valor_invalido: Value out of range or invalid format.
opciones.err_no_editable: The program is not available for editing.
opciones.err_base_ocupada: The record is busy. Try again in a few seconds.
opciones.err_f0: F0 is only available on laboratory equipment.
opciones.err_apertura_puertas_simples: Automatic opening is not available: the equipment has simple doors.
opciones.err_asignacion: The assignment does not meet the rules: one Main and up to two References.
opciones.err_sensor: A sensor in the assignment has no signal or is not installed.
opciones.err_sin_respuesta: No response from the equipment. The current value was checked; review it before retrying.
opciones.err_generico: The operation could not be completed.
opciones.mant_confirmar: A {tipo} maintenance completed today will be recorded. Do you want to continue?
opciones.mant_sin_dato: The system date is not reliable (earlier than the installation or changed): correct the date and time.
opciones.mant_err_reloj: The system clock is earlier than the installation or the last maintenance: correct the date and time.
opciones.mant_err_reloj_adelantado: The system clock appears to have been set ahead of its real progress: correct the date and time and restart the program before recording.
opciones.mant_intervalos_ayuda: Counted from installation or the last preventive maintenance; whichever comes first. 0 = not applicable.
opciones.err_modo_liquido: With a liquid load only depressurization modes 4, 5 and 0 are allowed: fast depressurization of hot liquid causes violent boiling.
opciones.err_coherencia_liquido: The program cannot switch to a liquid load: it must have no prevacuum, no drying, no automatic opening and enough cooling counterpressure.
opciones.aviso_modo_liquido: Liquid load: the depressurization mode changed to {modo} ({nombre}).
opciones.aviso_modo_solido: Solid load: the depressurization mode returned to {modo} ({nombre}).
opciones.aviso_liquido_previo: With a liquid load only depressurization modes 4, 5 and 0 are allowed. If the current mode is another one, it will change to mode 4 when saved.

menu.lista_truncada: Only the most recent cycles are shown

ciclo.cancelar_pregunta: The cycle in progress will be cancelled. Do you want to continue?
ciclo.cancelar_error: The cycle could not be cancelled. Check the connection with the controller and try again.
ciclo.confirmar_error: The end of the cycle could not be confirmed. Check the connection with the controller and try again.
ciclo.sin_bd_pregunta: Database not available. The cycle will run without an operator and without a database record (backup file and printout only). Do you want to continue without a record?
ciclo.cancelacion_en_espera_datos: Cancellation accepted: it will be applied when the control board data returns. If it does not return within a few seconds, the cycle ends with a communication failure.
ciclo.salidas_sin_confirmar_pendiente: Confirming that all outputs are off after test mode. Wait a few seconds.
ciclo.principal_sin_lectura: Main probe without reading: call service
ciclo.presion_camara_sin_lectura: Chamber pressure sensor without reading: call service
ciclo.presion_chaqueta_sin_lectura: Jacket pressure sensor without reading: call service
ciclo.presion_no_verificable: The pressure reading could not be checked: call service
ciclo.confirmar_estado_seguro_texto: The emergency stop was released. Check that there are no steam or water leaks before continuing. Confirming acknowledges the cycle result and brings the chamber to a safe state.

arranque.sin_progreso: No response from the control system

prueba_teclado.aviso: TEST SCREEN — not part of production navigation
prueba_teclado.reabrir: Tap here to reopen the keypad

notificaciones.despejar_sin_enlace: Cannot clear: the link with the control board has not returned to normal yet.
notificaciones.despejar_no_activa: Cannot clear: the alarm is no longer active.
notificaciones.despejar_rechazado: Cannot clear: the system rejected the request.
notificaciones.despejar_sin_respuesta: Cannot clear: no response from the control system. Try again.
notificaciones.despejar_sin_confirmacion: No confirmation was received in time: check whether the alarm is still listed.

equipo.apagar_pregunta: The equipment will shut down completely (including the PC). Do you want to continue?
equipo.apagado_windows_rechazado: Windows did not allow the equipment to shut down: shut it down manually
equipo.apagar_camara_no_segura: The chamber is not in a safe condition (DO NOT OPEN). The equipment will be taken out of service; do not open the doors.

exportacion.imprimir_en_ciclo: Cannot print while a cycle is in progress
exportacion.imprimir_error: Could not print: no connection with the equipment
exportacion.impresora_sin_papel: The printer is out of paper
exportacion.correo_invalido: The destination email is not valid
exportacion.correo_no_configurado: Email not configured: the sender or its password is missing
exportacion.error_datos: Could not send: no connection with the equipment
exportacion.error_autenticacion: Could not send the email: the sender or the password is not valid
exportacion.error_envio: Could not send the email: check the internet connection
exportacion.cuerpo: Attached are the selected autoclave cycles in PDF format, with their chart and their record.
exportacion.impreso_resumen: The summary was sent to the printer
exportacion.cuerpo_resumen: Attached is the cycle summary for the period in PDF format.
exportacion.cuerpo_consolidado: Attached is the consolidated report for the period in PDF format: the summary, the index and, for each cycle, its data, its chart with the setpoints and its record.
exportacion.enviado_consolidado: The consolidated report ({n} cycles) was sent to {destino}
exportacion.consolidado_demasiados: The period has {n} cycles; choose a shorter period (maximum {maximo})

reportes.consolidado_desc: A PDF will be sent with a cover (summary and index) and the pages of each cycle: data, chart with setpoints and record.
reportes.sin_ciclos_fallo: No cycles with this failure in the period

sistema.sin_conexion: No connection with the controller. The values shown are not up to date.
sistema.modo_prueba: TEST MODE ACTIVE — cycles are not valid for sterile loads
sistema.estado_seguro_causa_arranque: Start-up with the chamber not safe: the equipment brings it to a safe state on its own, without confirmation (there was no emergency stop).
sistema.estado_seguro_causa_fallo: Cycle failure: the equipment is bringing the chamber to a safe state.
sistema.estado_seguro_causa_cancelado: Cycle cancelled: the equipment is bringing the chamber to a safe state.
sistema.estado_seguro_causa_completado: Cycle finished with the chamber not safe: the equipment is bringing it to a safe state.
sistema.paro_liberado: Emergency stop released. Check that there is no leak before continuing.
sistema.confirmar_estado_seguro: Confirm and bring to safe state
sistema.estado_seguro_en_curso: Bringing the chamber to a safe state
sistema.estado_seguro_pendiente: Emergency stop released — safe state pending
sistema.paro_suelte: Release the emergency stop button to continue. Until then no actions are available.
sistema.confirmar_sin_sesion: Available to any operator, no login required
sistema.estado_seguro_detenido_accion: Check the Primary probe or assign another probe as Primary in OPTIONS › Cycle parameters › Sensors.
sistema.no_abrir_hasta_segura: DO NOT OPEN until the chamber is safe
sistema.seguridad_desconocida: No connection with the equipment: the emergency stop and the chamber cannot be verified. DO NOT OPEN.
sistema.tarjeta_desconectada: Board disconnected: the emergency stop and the chamber cannot be verified. DO NOT OPEN.
sistema.tarjeta_sin_datos: The board is not sending valid data: the emergency stop and the chamber cannot be verified. DO NOT OPEN.
sistema.tarjeta_desconectada_valores: Control board disconnected. The values shown are not up to date.
sistema.tarjeta_sin_datos_valores: The control board is not sending valid data. The values shown are not up to date.

sesion.usuario_bloqueado: User locked after failed attempts. Try again in {tiempo}
sesion.backend_no_responde: The equipment is not responding; try again
sesion.sesion_invalida: Invalid or expired session; sign in again
sesion.sesion_expirada: Session closed due to inactivity; sign in again
sesion.clave_pudo_cambiar: The password change could not be confirmed. Sign in with the new password; if it does not work, use the previous one.
sesion.sin_conexion_escrituras: No connection with the equipment: changes cannot be saved
sesion.sin_conexion_cierre: The session will close in {tiempo} if the connection is not restored
sesion.error_generico: The operation could not be completed
sesion.rol_sin_permiso: Your role does not have permission for this action
sesion.aviso_cambio_obligatorio: You must change your password before continuing
sesion.sin_bd: Database not available: login is not possible. Options, calibration and users are not available. Cycles can be started without an operator from the main menu.
sesion.vencida_mensaje: The session expired. Enter username (technician or engineer) and password.
sesion.ayuda_olvido_clave: Ask an administrator or an engineer to reset your password in OPTIONS › Users. You will receive a temporary password that you must change when you sign in.

usuarios.descartar_mensaje: The entered data will be lost.
usuarios.guardado_error: The user could not be saved
usuarios.rol_no_creable: Your role cannot create users with that role

validacion.formato: Letters, digits and . _ - only, {min} to {max} characters
validacion.reservado: That name is reserved by the system
validacion.igual_actual: The new password must be different from the current one
validacion.ASIGNACION_INVALIDA: The sensor assignment is not valid
validacion.SENSOR_NO_DISPONIBLE: A sensor in use has no reading or is not installed
validacion.ASIGNACION_SENSORES_INVALIDA: The program has an invalid sensor assignment

selector_ciclo.sin_conexion: No response from the equipment. Try again.
selector_ciclo.motivo_ciclo_en_curso: The cycle cannot be changed while one is running.
selector_ciclo.motivo_paro: The cycle cannot be changed while the emergency stop is pressed.
selector_ciclo.motivo_estado_seguro: The cycle cannot be changed while the chamber is being brought to a safe state.
selector_ciclo.motivo_modo_prueba: The cycle cannot be changed while test mode is active.
selector_ciclo.motivo_estado: The cycle cannot be changed in the current equipment state.

SIS-05.descripcion: Printer not connected. Reports will not be printed; check the cable and the printer.
SIS-05.accion: Check the USB cable and that the printer is on. The equipment can keep operating.
SIS-05.plantilla: Printer not connected. Reports will not be printed; check the cable and the printer.

COM-01.descripcion: The control board is not detected.
COM-01.accion: Connect the board (USB cable) and check its power supply.
COM-01.plantilla: The control board is not detected.

TARJETA_SIN_TRAMA_VALIDA.titulo: The I/O board is not sending valid data
TARJETA_SIN_TRAMA_VALIDA.accion: Check the USB cable and the board power supply. Call technical service.

TARJETA_SIN_ACK.titulo: The I/O board does not acknowledge commands

TARJETA_ALL_OFF_SIN_CONFIRMAR.titulo: The I/O board did not confirm outputs off

TARJETA_SALIDAS_NO_APAGADAS.titulo: I/O board outputs not switched off
TARJETA_SALIDAS_NO_APAGADAS.accion: Do not operate the equipment. Call technical service (power stage or expander).

TARJETA_WATCHDOG.titulo: The I/O board switched outputs off due to lost communication
TARJETA_WATCHDOG.accion: Check whether the control computer froze. If it happens again, call technical service.

TARJETA_REINICIO.accion: Check the board power supply. If it happens again, call technical service.

DISCREPANCIA_SALIDAS.titulo: Board outputs do not match the commanded state

SIS-01.plantilla: Emergency stop active in state {estado}. The stop input reads 0. If the button is not pressed, check that the wiring is a normally closed (NC) contact.
SIS-01.accion: Make sure there is no hazard and release the emergency stop button.

SIS-02.plantilla: The alarm history could not be saved: {error}. Alarms still work but are not recorded.

SIS-03.plantilla: The cycle backup could not be written: {error}. Without database, the cycle is recorded only on the ticket.
SIS-03.accion: Contact technical service: check disk space and permissions.

SUM-01.plantilla: Power supply was lost in phase {fase}. The cycle was aborted.
SUM-01.accion: Check the unit's power supply before restarting.

SUM-02.plantilla: The power supply signal is inactive.

SUM-03.titulo: No water for the vacuum pump
SUM-03.plantilla: The pump water supply signal is inactive.
SUM-03.accion: Open the pump water valve and check the mains pressure.

SUM-04.plantilla: The generator water supply signal is inactive.
SUM-04.accion: Open the generator water valve and check the mains pressure.

SUM-05.plantilla: The compressed air supply signal is inactive.
SUM-05.accion: Check the compressor and the air valve.

SUM-06.plantilla: No steam supply in state {estado}. The jacket waits until it returns.
SUM-06.accion: Check the generator and the steam valve.

PRE-01.plantilla: The jacket is at {pres:.0f} kPa, below the minimum of {minimo:.0f} kPa (target {objetivo:.0f} ± {rango:.0f}).
PRE-01.accion: Wait for the jacket to reach pressure. If it does not rise, check the steam supply.

PRE-02.plantilla: The jacket is at {pres:.0f} kPa, above the maximum of {maximo:.0f} kPa (target {objetivo:.0f} ± {rango:.0f}).

PRE-03.plantilla: The chamber is at {pres:.0f} kPa, below {minimo:.0f} kPa.
PRE-03.accion: Wait for the chamber to equalize with the atmosphere.

PRE-04.plantilla: The chamber is at {pres:.0f} kPa, above {maximo:.0f} kPa.
PRE-04.accion: Do not open the door. Wait for the chamber to depressurize.

PRE-05.plantilla: The level sensor detects water in the chamber. It is being drained.
PRE-05.accion: If it does not clear, check the chamber drain and the steam trap.

PRE-06.plantilla: The drain is at {temp:.1f} °C, above the maximum of {maximo:.1f} °C. Cooling was activated.

PUE-01.plantilla: {puerta} is open. The cycle cannot start.

PUE-02.plantilla: {puerta} was no longer detected closed in phase {fase}. The cycle was aborted.
PUE-02.accion: Check the door-closed sensor and the mechanical latch.

PUE-03.plantilla: The gasket of {puerta} dropped to {pres:.0f} kPa (minimum {minimo:.0f} kPa) in phase {fase}. The cycle was aborted.
PUE-03.accion: Check the compressed air and the gasket condition.

PUE-04.plantilla: {puerta} is opening without vacuum pump due to an electrical fault.

PUE-05.plantilla: {puerta} is closing without vacuum pump due to an electrical fault.

SEN-02.plantilla: No reading from: {sensores}, in phase {fase}. The cycle was aborted.
SEN-02.accion: Check the sensor connections before restarting.

SEN-03.plantilla: {sensor} gives no reading ({valor}). A program that uses it cannot start.
SEN-03.accion: Check the probe connection or set its role to Not in use.

SEN-04.plantilla: The chamber pressure sensor gives no reading in phase {fase}. The cycle was aborted: steam cut off and venting only through the slow valve.
SEN-04.accion: Do not open the door. Call technical service to check the chamber pressure sensor.

SEN-05.plantilla: The jacket pressure sensor gives no reading in phase {fase}. The cycle was aborted: steam cut off and venting only through the slow valve.
SEN-05.accion: Do not open the door until the chamber is confirmed safe. Call technical service to check the jacket pressure sensor.

SEN-08.plantilla: The gasket pressure sensor of {puerta} gives no reading in phase {fase}. The cycle was aborted: steam cut off and venting only through the slow valve.
SEN-08.accion: Do not open the door. Call technical service to check the gasket pressure sensor.

SEN-06.plantilla: Chamber pressure sensor without reading: call service.
SEN-06.accion: Do not open the door: without chamber pressure it cannot be confirmed safe. Call technical service.

SEN-07.plantilla: Jacket pressure sensor without reading: call service.
SEN-07.accion: Call technical service to check the jacket pressure sensor.

SEN-09.titulo: Input and output reassignment not verified
SEN-09.plantilla: Functions on a new port not verified: {funciones}. Cycles cannot be started.
SEN-09.accion: The engineer must verify each function in OPTIONS › Advanced options.

SEN-10.titulo: Chamber pressure inconsistent with the open door
SEN-10.plantilla: The door is open, but the chamber pressure does not match the atmospheric pressure. Cycles cannot be started.
SEN-10.accion: Possible causes: chamber pressure sensor calibration, wrong atmospheric reference pressure or door sensor. Call technical service.

SEN-11.plantilla: No reading from {sensor} in the {fase} phase. The cycle continues with the probes that read and is marked NONCONFORMING: reference point not verified.
SEN-11.accion: Check the reference probe connection. Validate the load according to your procedure before releasing it.

CIC-02.accion: Check the vacuum pump and its seal water.

CIC-03.accion: Check the steam supply and the generator pressure.

CIC-04.accion: The load is NOT sterile. Check the steam supply and repeat the cycle.

CIC-05.accion: Do not open the door until atmospheric pressure is confirmed. Check the exhaust valves.

CIC-06.accion: Check the vacuum pump. The load may come out wet.

CIC-07.plantilla: The chamber is still at {temp:.1f} °C (maximum to open {maximo:.1f} °C) after {minutos:.0f} min.
CIC-07.accion: Wait. The door will open by itself when cool.

CIC-09.plantilla: {sensor} is at {temp:.1f} °C, outside the sterilization range ({minimo:.1f}–{maximo:.1f} °C). The cycle is still controlled by the Main sensor.
CIC-09.accion: Check the load and the position of the reference probe.

CIC-10.plantilla: {motivo}. The chamber is still not considered safe.
CIC-10.accion: Do not open the door. Check the Main probe or assign another probe as Main in OPTIONS › Cycle parameters › Sensors (technician or engineer). If it is not resolved, call technical service.
CIC-10.accion_sin_presion: Do not open the door. Without the chamber pressure sensor the chamber cannot be brought to a safe state. Check the chamber pressure sensor connection or call technical service.

CIC-11.plantilla: The pauses caused by missing control board data added up to {segundos:.0f} s during sterilization (maximum {maximo:.0f} s). The cycle was aborted.
CIC-11.accion: The load is NOT sterile. Check the USB cable and the board's power supply and repeat the cycle. If it happens again, call technical service.

CIC-12.titulo: Air or non-condensable gases in the chamber
CIC-12.plantilla: The chamber pressure corresponds to a saturation temperature of {tsat:.1f} °C, {dt:.1f} K above the Main sensor ({temp:.1f} °C). The cycle was aborted.
CIC-12.accion: The load is NOT sterile. Check air removal (prevacuum, Bowie & Dick test and chamber leaks) and repeat the cycle.

CIC-13.plantilla: The Main sensor reads {temp:.1f} °C, {dt:.1f} K above the saturation temperature of the chamber pressure ({tsat:.1f} °C). The cycle was aborted.
CIC-13.accion: The load is NOT sterile. Check the Main probe and the chamber pressure sensor (calibration) and the supply steam, and repeat the cycle.

CIC-14.titulo: Reference out of band during sterilization
CIC-14.plantilla: {sensor} stayed outside the sterilization band for more than {minutos} min. The cycle was aborted.
CIC-14.accion: The load is NOT sterile. Check the load, its position and the reference probe, and repeat the cycle.

COM-02.plantilla: Communication with the board was lost for more than {segundos:.1f} s in phase {fase}. The cycle was aborted.
COM-02.accion: Check the USB cable and the board's power supply before restarting.

OPERANDO_SIN_BD.plantilla: Database not available: cycles are recorded only in the backup and on the ticket, without operator. Options, calibration and users are not available.
OPERANDO_SIN_BD.accion: Call technical service to check the database.

SIS-04.accion: Schedule maintenance with technical service. The unit can keep operating.

CONFIGURACION_INVALIDA.accion: Call technical service to correct the configuration.

COM-03.titulo: I/O board failure during the cycle
COM-03.accion: Check the I/O board before restarting. Call technical service.

COM-04.plantilla: The control board did not confirm that all outputs were switched off when leaving test mode, even after 3 retries. The connection with the board is being restarted.
COM-04.accion: Do not start cycles. If the alarm does not clear by itself, call technical service.

io.err_sin_base: No audit record: the change was not applied.
io.err_sin_previa: There is no previous calibration to restore.
io.err_confirmacion: The calibration is outside the usual range and needs confirmation.
io.err_implausible: The calibration is not plausible and cannot be applied.
io.err_aire_con_presion: The atmospheric air valve cannot be opened: the chamber is pressurized. Wait until the chamber is at atmospheric pressure.
io.err_aire_sin_presion: The atmospheric air valve cannot be opened: there is no chamber pressure reading.
io.err_aire_sin_referencia: The atmospheric air valve cannot be opened: the equipment reference atmospheric pressure is missing.
io.err_puerta_camara_no_segura: The door cannot be unlocked or opened: the chamber is not safe (pressure, temperature or no reading) or is being brought to a safe state.
io.err_salida_estado_seguro: This output cannot be switched on: the chamber is being brought to a safe state.

ui.enlace_perdido: No link with the I/O board

Only the entrapment safeguard and the atmospheric air lock (pressurized chamber or no pressure reading) stay active. Use it only if you know the system.
ui.atrapamiento_aviso: With the entrapment safeguard active, the close command opens the door.
ui.sin_permiso_prueba: Test mode is not available in this state or for this user.
ui.cerrar_sesion_prueba: Test mode is active: logging out will turn the outputs off.
ui.sin_lectura: No valid reading: check the sensor wiring
ui.cal_confirmar_titulo: The calibration is outside the usual range. Apply it anyway?
ui.cal_confirmar_restaurar: Restore the calibration? The change is logged.
ui.cal_polinomio: This channel has an active calibration polynomial: the new line replaces it.

globals.F0: Enables lethality (F0) calculation: sterilization ends only when both the time and the target F0 are met.
globals.F0_objetivo: Minimum accumulated lethality required for the sterilization to be valid.
globals.ciclos_multiples: Allows chaining several cycles without returning to the menu in between.
globals.enfriar_chaqueta_secado: Cools the jacket during drying at the end of the cycle.
globals.presion_chaqueta: Pressure held in the jacket before and during the cycle.
globals.rango_presion_chaqueta: Tolerance (±) around the jacket pressure; outside it an alert is raised and starting is not allowed.
globals.tipo_carga: Load type: solid or liquid. With a liquid load only depressurization modes 4, 5 and 0 are allowed: switching to liquid changes the mode to 4 (if it was not 4, 5 or 0) and switching back to solid restores the program default mode.

precalentamiento.tiempo_precalentamiento: Time the jacket is held hot before moving on to pre-vacuum.
precalentamiento.presion_precalentamiento: Jacket pressure to reach and hold during preheating.
precalentamiento.timeout_precalentamiento: Maximum preheating time; if exceeded, the cycle fails.

prevacio.timeout_bajo: Maximum time to reach the low pressure of a pulse; if exceeded, the cycle fails.
prevacio.timeout_alto: Maximum time to reach the high pressure of a pulse; if exceeded, the cycle fails.
prevacio.conteo_pulso_a: Number of repetitions of pulse A (0 = pulse is skipped).
prevacio.presion_alta_pulso_a: Pressure the chamber is raised to with steam on each repetition of pulse A.
prevacio.tiempo_adicional_alto_a: Extra seconds the high pressure of pulse A is held.
prevacio.presion_baja_pulso_a: Vacuum pressure the chamber is lowered to on each repetition of pulse A.
prevacio.tiempo_adicional_bajo_a: Extra seconds the vacuum of pulse A is held.
prevacio.conteo_pulso_b: Number of repetitions of pulse B (0 = pulse is skipped).
prevacio.presion_alta_pulso_b: Pressure the chamber is raised to with steam on each repetition of pulse B.
prevacio.tiempo_adicional_alto_b: Extra seconds the high pressure of pulse B is held.
prevacio.presion_baja_pulso_b: Vacuum pressure the chamber is lowered to on each repetition of pulse B.
prevacio.tiempo_adicional_bajo_b: Extra seconds the vacuum of pulse B is held.
prevacio.conteo_pulso_c: Number of repetitions of pulse C (0 = pulse is skipped).
prevacio.presion_alta_pulso_c: Pressure the chamber is raised to with steam on each repetition of pulse C.
prevacio.tiempo_adicional_alto_c: Extra seconds the high pressure of pulse C is held.
prevacio.presion_baja_pulso_c: Vacuum pressure the chamber is lowered to on each repetition of pulse C.
prevacio.tiempo_adicional_bajo_c: Extra seconds the vacuum of pulse C is held.
prevacio.conteo_pulso_d: Number of repetitions of pulse D (0 = pulse is skipped).
prevacio.presion_alta_pulso_d: Pressure the chamber is raised to with steam on each repetition of pulse D.
prevacio.tiempo_adicional_alto_d: Extra seconds the high pressure of pulse D is held.
prevacio.presion_baja_pulso_d: Vacuum pressure the chamber is lowered to on each repetition of pulse D.
prevacio.tiempo_adicional_bajo_d: Extra seconds the vacuum of pulse D is held.

calentamiento.temperatura_calentamiento: Target temperature at the end of the heating ramp.
calentamiento.presion_add_calentamiento: Extra pressure above saturation allowed as a ceiling during the ramp.
calentamiento.timeout_calentamiento: Maximum heating ramp time; if exceeded, the cycle fails.
calentamiento.factor_calentamiento: Percentage of steam reduction when nearing the targets to avoid overshoot.
calentamiento.rango_calentamiento_temp: Temperature distance to the target from which steam is reduced; also sets how much temperature overshoot is tolerated.
calentamiento.rango_calentamiento_pres: Pressure distance to the target from which steam is reduced; also sets how much pressure overshoot is tolerated.
calentamiento.tiempo_estable_preesterilizacion: Continuous time within range required before moving on to sterilization.
calentamiento.intervalo_segmentos_calor: Period of the steam open/close cycle during heating.
calentamiento.escape_lento_on: Seconds the slow exhaust stays open on each repetition.
calentamiento.escape_lento_off: Seconds the slow exhaust stays closed (0 = always open).
calentamiento.escape_rapido_on: Seconds the fast exhaust stays open on each repetition (0 = always closed).
calentamiento.escape_rapido_off: Seconds the fast exhaust stays closed between openings.
calentamiento.rango_temp_estabilizacion: Temperature margin within which the chamber is considered stable before sterilizing.
calentamiento.timeout_recuperacion_estabilizacion: Maximum time to regain stability after leaving the range.

estabilizacion.tiempo_estabilizacion: Time the chamber must stay stable before sterilizing.
estabilizacion.timeout_recuperacion: Maximum time to return to range before declaring a failure.

esterilizacion.escape_lento_on_ester: Seconds the slow exhaust stays open on each repetition during sterilization.
esterilizacion.escape_lento_off_ester: Seconds the slow exhaust stays closed (0 = always open).
esterilizacion.escape_rapido_on_ester: Seconds the fast exhaust stays open on each repetition (0 = always closed).
esterilizacion.escape_rapido_off_ester: Seconds the fast exhaust stays closed between openings.
esterilizacion.tiempo_esterilizacion: Duration of the hold at sterilization temperature.
esterilizacion.factor_esterilizacion: Percentage of the period the steam stays closed while pressure is within the band.
esterilizacion.presion_add_esterilizacion: Pressure above saturation at which steam is cut (control ceiling).
esterilizacion.intervalo_segmentos_ester: Period of the steam open/close cycle during sterilization.
esterilizacion.rango_temperatura_ester: Maximum overtemperature allowed; above it the cycle fails.
esterilizacion.rango_presion_ester: Maximum overpressure above saturation allowed; above it the cycle fails.
esterilizacion.brecha_segura_temperatura: Margin above the target temperature to switch from recovery to fine control.
esterilizacion.brecha_error_temperatura: Temperature drop below the target considered a failure.
esterilizacion.brecha_error_presion: Pressure drop below saturation considered a failure.
esterilizacion.brecha_segura_presion: Pressure drop that triggers recovery; must be smaller than the failure drop.

secado.modo: How the load is dried: 1, 2 or 3 depending on the unit.
secado.rango_chaqueta_secado: Tolerance (±) of the jacket pressure during drying.
secado.presion_baja_secado: Low chamber pressure on each drying vacuum pulse.
secado.presion_alta_secado: High chamber pressure on each drying pulse.
secado.timeout_pulso: Maximum time of each drying pulse; if exceeded, the cycle fails.

descompresion.modo: How pressure is released after sterilization. See the description of the chosen mode.

modo_1.timeout: Maximum time of mode 1; if exceeded, the cycle fails.

modo_2.timeout: Maximum time of mode 2; if exceeded, the cycle fails.

modo_3.presion_cambio: Pressure at which the slow exhaust hands over to the fast one.
modo_3.timeout: Maximum time of mode 3; if exceeded, the cycle fails.

modo_4.timeout: Maximum time of mode 4; if exceeded, the cycle fails.
modo_4.presion_camara_enfriamiento: Pressure held in the chamber with compressed air while cooling.
modo_4.temperatura_enfriamiento: Temperature below which the load is considered cooled and depressurization starts.
modo_4.tiempo_apertura_chaqueta: Seconds the jacket drain stays open on each pulse.
modo_4.tiempo_cierre_chaqueta: Seconds the drain stays closed between pulses (0 = always open).

modo_5.timeout: Maximum time of mode 5; if exceeded, the cycle fails.
modo_5.presion_camara_enfriamiento: Pressure held in the chamber with compressed air while cooling.
modo_5.temperatura_enfriamiento: Temperature below which the load is considered cooled and depressurization starts.
modo_5.tiempo_apertura_chaqueta: Seconds the jacket drain stays open on each pulse.
modo_5.tiempo_cierre_chaqueta: Seconds the drain stays closed between pulses (0 = always open).

finalizacion.tiempo_espera_apertura: Fixed wait after the cycle ends before the door opens automatically.
finalizacion.temp_max_apertura: Maximum chamber temperature that allows automatic opening.
finalizacion.timeout_temperatura: Time after which a warning is raised if the chamber does not cool to the opening temperature.
finalizacion.apertura_automatica: Opens the unload door by itself and confirms the cycle after a successful end.

0.desc: No exhaust: the chamber cools and drops to atmospheric pressure on its own.

1.desc: Opens the fast exhaust from the start and drops pressure as quickly as possible. For solid loads.

2.desc: Opens only the slow exhaust: pressure drops gradually. For loads sensitive to sudden changes.

3.desc: Slow exhaust down to the switch pressure, then fast exhaust until atmospheric.

4.desc: Cools with jacket water and holds pressure with compressed air until below the cooling temperature, then opens the fast exhaust. For liquid loads.

5.desc: Like mode 4, but assisted by the slow exhaust during cooling, then opens the fast exhaust.

calibracion_atm.guia: The unit measures chamber pressure for 2 minutes (one sample every 5 s) and takes it as the reference atmospheric pressure. It cannot be typed in.
calibracion_atm.criterios: Accepted if the average is between {min} and {max} kPa absolute and the spread is {disp} kPa or less. If it differs from the previous value by more than {dif} kPa, confirmation is required. If a condition is lost, the measurement is cancelled and not retried.
calibracion_atm.confirmar_pregunta: The measured value ({nuevo}) differs widely from the previous one ({anterior}). Apply it as the reference atmospheric pressure?
calibracion_atm.res_por_confirmar: The measured value differs from the previous one by more than {dif} kPa: confirm or discard it.
calibracion_atm.res_abortada: Calibration cancelled: {motivo}. The previous value is kept.
calibracion_atm.res_rechazada: Calibration rejected: {motivo}. The previous value is kept.
calibracion_atm.motivo_temp_baja: chamber temperature exceeded the limit or its reading was lost
calibracion_atm.motivo_lecturas_validas: a pressure or temperature reading was lost
calibracion_atm.motivo_fuera_de_rango: the average is outside the accepted range
calibracion_atm.motivo_confirmacion_vencida: it was not confirmed in time
calibracion_atm.motivo_incoherente: the value is inconsistent with the gasket pressure and vacuum
calibracion_atm.err_precondicion: The conditions for calibrating are not met.
calibracion_atm.err_impresora: The printer is not ready (disconnected, out of paper or in error).
calibracion_atm.err_impresion_ciclo: Cannot print while a cycle is running.

conectividad.prueba_enviada: Test email sent to the saved recipients.

respaldo.restaurado_reinicio: Backup restored. Restart the software to apply the calibration and programs.
respaldo.err_usb: The USB drive is not detected.
respaldo.err_usb_escritura: Could not write to the USB drive.
respaldo.err_sin_partes: Choose at least one part to export.
respaldo.err_invalido: The backup is damaged or invalid.

gestion_usuarios.motivo_propio: You cannot deactivate yourself; change your own password in Change password.
gestion_usuarios.motivo_rol_objetivo: Your role cannot modify users with that role.
gestion_usuarios.confirmar_desactivar: Deactivate user {usuario}? Their open sessions will be closed.
gestion_usuarios.confirmar_restablecer: Reset the password of {usuario}? They must change it at their next login.

gestion_usuarios.err_rol_objetivo: Your role cannot modify users with that role.

gestion_usuarios.err_no_existe: The user or operator no longer exists.

gestion_usuarios.err_cuenta_sistema: System accounts cannot be deactivated, deleted, renamed or have their role changed.

prevacio.tiempo_adicional_alto_a: Extra time at high pressure A
prevacio.tiempo_adicional_bajo_a: Extra time at low pressure A
prevacio.tiempo_adicional_alto_b: Extra time at high pressure B
prevacio.tiempo_adicional_bajo_b: Extra time at low pressure B

prevacio.timeout_bajo: Time limit to reach low pressure

estado_seguro_motivos.sonda_temperatura: Main probe without reading: the safe state cannot confirm the temperature
estado_seguro_motivos.sonda_enfriamiento: Main probe without reading: cooling cannot be confirmed

estado_seguro_motivos.sonda_liquido_sellada: Main probe without reading with a liquid load: chamber sealed until the probes confirm the temperature or the wait expires

motivos_fase.cal_tiempo_limite: Heating time limit: the target was not reached in {minutos} min
motivos_fase.cal_tiempo_limite_sostenimiento: Heating time limit ({minutos} min) during the hold: the stability window was extended {segundos} s by periods without control board data

motivos_fase.sec_termino_sin_vacio: Drying mode {modo}: ended without reaching real vacuum

motivos_fase.sec_modo3_aire_alto: Drying mode 3: the high air pressure was not reached in time

ticket_ciclo.aviso_excursion_alta: Excursion of {sensor}: {duracion} s out of band, minimum {temp_min}, maximum {temp_max}

modos_programa.secado_intro: How the load is dried. In modes 1 and 2 the chamber must reach vacuum within the pulse time limit and keep it; otherwise the cycle fails.
modos_programa.secado_1_linea: Vacuum pump and valve open the whole time.
modos_programa.secado_2_linea: Continuous vacuum with the atmospheric air inlet open.
modos_programa.secado_3_linea: Alternates vacuum down to the low pressure and air up to the high drying pressure.
modos_programa.descompresion_intro: How chamber pressure is released after sterilization. The mode is read when the phase starts.
modos_programa.descompresion_nota_liquido: With a liquid load only modes 4, 5 and 0 are allowed: fast depressurization of hot liquid causes violent boiling.
modos_programa.descompresion_0_linea: All valves closed: pressure drops on its own, with no time limit.
modos_programa.descompresion_1_linea: Fast exhaust open until atmospheric pressure.
modos_programa.descompresion_2_linea: Slow exhaust open until atmospheric pressure.
modos_programa.descompresion_3_linea: Slow exhaust down to the switch pressure, then the fast one.
modos_programa.descompresion_4_linea: For liquids: jacket water and compressed air as counterpressure until the load cools.
modos_programa.descompresion_5_linea: Like mode 4, with the slow exhaust open during cooling.

manejo_ciclos.explicacion: Create a new program from an existing one, duplicate, enable or disable programs and delete custom ones. Factory programs cannot be deleted.
manejo_ciclos.crear_explicacion: Choose the base program: the new program copies all its parameters. Then type the name.
manejo_ciclos.borrar_pregunta: Delete program {nombre}? Its number will not be used again.

manejo_ciclos.err_estado: Not allowed while a cycle is running.

manejo_ciclos.err_identidad: The session is not valid: log in again.
manejo_ciclos.err_nombre_invalido: Invalid name: type 1 to 40 characters, without line breaks.
manejo_ciclos.err_nombre_repetido: A program with that name already exists.
manejo_ciclos.err_programa_activo: The selected program cannot be disabled or deleted.
manejo_ciclos.err_no_duplicable: This program cannot be duplicated: it is damaged or outside the catalog.

reasignacion.aviso: Use this function only if a board port is damaged. Each change is applied by restarting the control and is recorded in the audit log.
reasignacion.alerta_texto: You are about to change the port of {n} functions. A function on the wrong port can operate a valve or a door without control. Check the wiring before continuing.
reasignacion.alerta_analogicas: A reassigned analog input uses the calibration of its new port: calibrate it before using the equipment.
reasignacion.reforzada_texto: This is a safety function (door interlock, emergency stop or limit switch). Type its name exactly as shown: {funcion}
reasignacion.reinicio_texto: Type your password to confirm. The outputs will be switched off and the control will restart to apply the assignment. Then each function will be checked on its new port.
reasignacion.restaurar_texto: All functions will return to their factory port.
reasignacion.reiniciando: Restarting the control to apply the assignment…
reasignacion.guardado_sin_reinicio: Assignment saved: it will be applied the next time the control starts.
reasignacion.reinicio_pendiente: A saved assignment is not applied yet: restart the control.
reasignacion.bloqueo: The saved assignment is damaged: the equipment is locked until the factory assignment is restored.
reasignacion.motivo_ciclo: Not available while a cycle is running.
reasignacion.motivo_estado: Available only with the equipment in preparation or ready: clear the fault first.
reasignacion.motivo_modo_prueba: Leave the output test mode first.
reasignacion.motivo_estado_seguro: Wait until the chamber reaches the safe state.
reasignacion.err_conflicto: Two functions cannot share the same port.
reasignacion.err_puerto_inexistente: That port does not exist on the board for this type of function.
reasignacion.err_sin_cambios: There are no changes to apply.
reasignacion.err_nombre: The typed name does not match the function name.
reasignacion.err_bloqueado: User locked after failed attempts: wait 5 minutes.
reasignacion.err_estado: Reassignment is not possible in the current equipment state.
reasignacion.err_rol: Only the engineer can reassign inputs and outputs.
reasignacion.err_guardar: The assignment could not be saved.
reasignacion.err_generico: The reassignment could not be applied.
reasignacion.sin_verificar_aviso: Some reassigned functions are not verified: cycles cannot be started until they are verified in the list below.
reasignacion.verificar_texto_di: Operate the input (for example, open and close the door or press and release the stop) and check in Inputs / Outputs that it changes. The control already saw the change on the new port. Confirm only if you checked it.
reasignacion.verificar_texto_do: You already turned this output on in test mode after reassigning it. Confirm only if you checked that the right valve or actuator operates.
reasignacion.verificar_texto_ai: The reading is valid and the sensor was calibrated on its new port after reassigning it. Confirm only if the reading matches the reference.
reasignacion.verif_trama_presente: {funcion}: the board sends {puerto}; the engineer must still verify it
reasignacion.falta_sin_cambio_observado: Missing: operate the input to see a state change on the new port.
